notes.title: The Divine Speaker: A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Today we have a little announcement...


[url=https://discord.gg/twohalfstudios][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/4ca6a34cf1fe9c80821397cf4782ff927968ac99.png[/img][/url]

A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas, a festive themed Leos afterstory, is coming to Steam this December!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/07728d9ad6a148e34706aec4664fff53f4060dae.png[/img]

[b]The Divine Speaker: A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas is an 18+ Leos-centric afterstory to The Divine Speaker set during the Winter Solstice.

When Zarryn and Titus send the pair on a mission to hunt down the elusive Mister Bells, how will Raen and Leos manage to balance their first Winter Solstice and their (very well paying) job?

A hilarious story with hints about the future of The Divine Speaker awaits you![/b]

This after story was exclusive to our Patreon for one year, and will now be releasing publicly. In the future, we plan that most of our exclusive DLCs will come to Steam after a one year period!

Wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2495960/The_Divine_Speaker_A_Bounty_Hunters_First_Christmas/

🎁 Over 25,000 words of story that comes after the end of The Divine Speaker
🎁 Two brand new CGs from lead game artist Fuyuure
🎁 Beautiful chibi CGs by Tsy Shen
🎁 Choose between a Leos top or Raen top scene
🎁 A rock-paper-scissors show off against Leos


Support to our Patreon made this DLC possible, and now we hope an even wider amount of our audience can try out the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/43504721687dd4565422872a54a88f98d30bcdda.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/486f8097345f894cefbc389695bc40d26b77449e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/b248d2b3c5fa6b70780cf76d0c77cb96a97a747c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/0d41027df3bf5445280aa9e7b6a3b190620657c2.png[/img]

Note: This game does not contain voice acting, and we don't anticipate for any of the DLCs/afterstories that are possibly created in the future to contain it.

notes.title: The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/ea42033ecd50c1cdc456694f507665c802cfdbd9.png[/img]

[h1]The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon is out NOW on Steam![/h1]

[i]Journey to the past with The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon, an enthralling fantasy visual novel and 18+ prequel to the popular BL game, The Divine Speaker.

Follow the intertwining journeys of Lucius and Aemyl as they navigate their past and future, each grappling with the fate they have been dealt. Will they be able to find a happy future, or does only pain and suffering await them?

Lucius longs for a past that he cannot return to, while Aemyl is fixated on creating a future that may not come to pass. As their paths cross and their stories become intertwined, each must come to terms with the destiny that awaits them... or refuse to accept it.

In a game of the past and the future, the sun and the moon, who will come out on top?
[/i]

[previewyoutube=bxZWN25LkA8;full][/previewyoutube]

🌙 Immerse yourself in over 80,000 words of captivating fantasy storytelling, with dual storylines that are woven together to form a mesmerizing narrative that explores the depths of love, loss, and sacrifice. ​

☀️ Embark on a linear journey (no choices) that leads directly into the beginning of The Divine Speaker, the game that started it all.​

🌙 Feast your eyes on the stunning original artwork by Fuyuure, the original game's talented artist. ​

☀️ Explore 18+ scenes and artworks and the intimate relationships that come along with them.

🌙 Meet brand new characters... plus some returning ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280961/ebd10f3e924366ffae04ba57a9925ede751f37d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280961/55aaa8d630513615f8f3d6f638f68f1ae63dc97a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42280961/3e696ddcb7d28af486cce3bb7f96bb4399190642.png[/img]

Buy the game now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1973640/The_Divine_Speaker_The_Sun_and_the_Moon/

If you enjoy it, please consider leaving a review!
